items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Harry Fox, living that time, he called me

ctx.x:
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Harry Fox, living that time, he called me and asked me would I come up and listen to some songs that they had found in bootlegging and tell him what was the titles of them, because they had no titles on them.
They called them something else. And they -- no, this is so and so song.
